text:
Sasha: quick POC ask from Ember Health — can we get their custom model (ember-neo-30b-v1) live in the catalog for a demo next week? Requirements: streaming, ~8k+ context, KV cache, strict no-retention for PHI, and a deterministic pricing band for enterprise SOC2 customers.
Tariq: do they provide HF checkpoint + tokenizer and any custom ops docs? also need shard layout.
Sasha: HF archive + tokenizer included, single-shard 30B fp16. They asked if we can supply a q4f variant for cost. s3 path: s3://ember-poc/models/ember-neo-30b-v1/weights.tar.gz
Yvonne: eyeballing the repo — model looks llama-architected but with a fused op `fused_geglu_norm` and a custom pre-tokenizer stage. Two concerns: kernel support for fused op, and tokenizer adapter.
Connor: infra note: for sustained 8k seq with quantized weights you need >=48GB VRAM (H100-80/4 A100-80 style) or KV sharding. For demo, a 2xH100 pool or 3xA100 pool is suggested.
Emma: security checklist: confirm no-retention setting, will they accept customer-managed KMS, and do we need DPA + SOC2 attestation? if PHI appears we require explicit confirmation on handling and optional on-prem.
Tariq: kicking off variant-scan now. Command I'll run (internal):
```
variant-scan --model s3://ember-poc/models/ember-neo-30b-v1/weights.tar.gz --out /tmp/ember-variant.json --checks ops,tokenizer,quantize
```
Tariq: preliminary scan result: `fused_geglu_norm` not in our optimized kernel catalog -> execution falls back to generic CUDA kernel (expected perf ~40-60% of optimized path). Tokenizer uses custom pre-tokenize step; we can wrap with a tiny adapter.
Yvonne: implication: streaming latency for 8k might degrade. Options: 1) ask Ember to produce a variant without fused op 2) build an optimized kernel adapter (2-3 dev days) 3) restrict demo context to 4k + KV prefix to appear long.
Connor: run-time mitigation: enable KV prefix caching and aggressive prefix trimming for demo. That will reduce per-request token perf pressure. For production we should recommend Dedicated with pinned pool.
Emma: security next steps: send Ember our security questionnaire and DPA template. Require confirmation of no retention and KMS details (customer-managed preferred). Provide on-prem packaging notes if they insist on air-gapped.
Sasha: Ember asked for immediate pricing guidance: can we give a quick hosted vs dedicated ballpark for q4f 30B?
Connor: quick ballpark (very rough): hosted q4f 30B generation ~ $0.08 / 1k tokens => ~$80 / 1M tokens. Dedicated (amortized) assuming 1x 60k/month pool and ~50% utilization -> ~ $30k/month effective cost -> if they consume 1M tokens/day (~30M/month) that's ~ $1.00 / 1k tokens. Heavy caveats: utilization, batching, and caching change this wildly.
Tariq: also flag one-time eng effort for conversion/adapter if Ember won't remove fused op: estimate 8-24 engineer-hours depending on whether we implement kernel or they re-export clean weights.
Yvonne: I'll prepare a demo-specific catalog entry `ember-neo-30b-demo` that uses conservative defaults:
```
model: ember-neo-30b-demo
quant: q4f
max_seq: 4096
kv_cache: enabled
streaming: true
fallback_policy: degrade-to-4k
```
Sasha: action items roundup:
- Tariq: finish variant-scan, try q4f conversion, upload artifact (ETA EOD)
- Yvonne: draft demo config + perf note (use 4k demo + KV prefix)
- Connor: cost comparison doc + infra recommendation (hosted vs dedicated)
- Emma: send security checklist + DPA link to Ember, ask Q14 about PHI handling
Tariq: uploaded scan artifact to internal bucket: s3://redwood-internal/scans/1765554321-ember-variant.json
Sasha: I'll reply to Ember with the demo compromise (4k streaming + KV cache for demo), the security steps, and a tentative pricing band. tagging @Tariq @Yvonne @Connor @Emma.
Emma: sending security checklist to Ember now. Also ask their security contact to complete our online form and provide SOC2 cert if available.
Connor: note for sales: when pitching dedicated, show cost sensitivity with utilization examples (10%, 50%, 90%) — helps them see commit tradeoffs.
Sasha: thanks everyone — will update thread after Ember confirms whether they can strip fused op or want us to build adapter. :white_check_mark:
